moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League serves up a packed schedule this weekend, with Chelsea, Liverpool, Manchester City, Arsenal, and Manchester United all in action.

angles.name: Saturday Showdowns
angles.copy: It's a big Saturday in the Premier League! Everton host Chelsea, Brentford take on Liverpool, Man City face Ipswich Town, and Newcastle clash with Aston Villa. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Sunday & Monday Matches
angles.copy: The Premier League continues Sunday with Leeds v Man Utd and Nottingham Forest v Arsenal, then Tottenham host Coventry City on Monday night. Don't miss a kick!

moments.title: Championship Saturday
moments.blurb: The EFL Championship features several key matchups today, including Middlesbrough vs Cardiff City and Swansea City vs West Ham.

angles.name: Welsh Derby Day
angles.copy: Big Championship action today! Middlesbrough host Cardiff City, while Swansea City take on West Ham. Massive games for our Welsh clubs!

angles.name: Wrexham in Action
angles.copy: Wrexham are at home today in the Championship, facing Preston North End! Tune in for all the updates.

moments.title: Oktoberfest Exeter Castle
moments.blurb: Exeter's biggest Oktoberfest event takes over Exeter Castle today with live oompah bands, German beer, bratwurst, and pretzels.

angles.name: Prost in Exeter!
angles.copy: It's Oktoberfest at Exeter Castle today! Expect steins, bratwurst, and live oompah bands. Are you heading down?

angles.name: Bavarian Vibes
angles.copy: Grab your lederhosen! Exeter Castle is transforming into a Bavarian beer hall for Oktoberfest today. Day and evening sessions available!

moments.title: Cardiff Music City Festival Finale
moments.blurb: The innovative Cardiff Music City Festival concludes today, bringing together musicians and tech specialists for unique collaborations across the city.

angles.name: Cardiff Music Finale
angles.copy: It's the final day of the Cardiff Music City Festival! Catch the last of the unique collaborations and unmissable events happening across the capital.

angles.name: What's On Cardiff
angles.copy: From immersive tech to live performances, the Cardiff Music City Festival wraps up today. What's been your highlight?

moments.title: Official UK Singles Chart Update
moments.blurb: The latest Official UK Singles Chart for the week ending October 17, 2026, sees Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' holding the top spot for a second week, with new entries and re-entries from various artists.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Taylor Swift's 'Patient Zero' is still number one on the Official UK Singles Chart! Who else made the Top 10 this week?

angles.name: New Entries & Re-entries
angles.copy: The charts are buzzing! New tracks from Noah Kahan and Drake are in, plus classic re-entries from The Killers ('Mr. Brightside') and Natasha Bedingfield ('Unwritten').

moments.title: 'Thriller' Climbs UK Charts
moments.blurb: Michael Jackson's iconic 'Thriller' is climbing the UK charts, re-entering the Singles Sales and Downloads charts, driven by the Halloween season and renewed interest from his biopic.

angles.name: Thriller Season
angles.copy: It's spooky season and Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' is back on the UK charts and climbing! Are you ready to dance like a zombie?

angles.name: King of Pop's Return
angles.copy: Michael Jackson's 'Thriller' is seeing a huge resurgence on the charts, thanks to Halloween and the buzz around his biopic! What a timeless classic.

moments.title: Champions League Matchday 3
moments.blurb: The UEFA Champions League returns for Matchday 3 on October 20-21, with several English clubs in action, including Liverpool, Manchester City, Manchester United, Arsenal, and Aston Villa.

angles.name: Midweek European Nights
angles.copy: Champions League Matchday 3 kicks off Tuesday! Liverpool host Villarreal and Man City face AEK Athens. Who are you backing for a win?

angles.name: Big Games Wednesday
angles.copy: Wednesday brings more Champions League drama: Man Utd travel to Como, Aston Villa play Viking FK, and Arsenal face Bayern Munich. European action is heating up!

moments.title: Bournemouth Symphony Orchestra in Exeter
moments.blurb: The Bournemouth Symphony Orchestra performs 'Glorious Heights' at Exeter University Great Hall on Thursday, October 22, featuring works by Tippett, Vaughan Williams, Adès and Sibelius.

angles.name: Classical Night in Exeter
angles.copy: The Bournemouth Symphony Orchestra brings 'Glorious Heights' to Exeter University Great Hall this Thursday! A night of stunning classical music awaits.

angles.name: BSO in Devon
angles.copy: Don't miss the Bournemouth Symphony Orchestra in Exeter this Thursday, October 22nd. Featuring an exciting programme with soloist Anthony Marwood.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Shaggy
moments.blurb: Reggae fusion icon Shaggy, known for hits like 'It Wasn't Me' and 'Boombastic', celebrates his 58th birthday on October 22.

angles.name: It Wasn't Just Me
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the one and only Mr. Lover Lover, Shaggy! What's your favourite track from the reggae superstar?

angles.name: Boombastic Birthday
angles.copy: Feeling Boombastic? It's Shaggy's 58th birthday on October 22nd! Get ready to crank up the reggae fusion hits.

moments.title: Happy Birthday 21 Savage
moments.blurb: British-American rapper 21 Savage, known for his distinctive flow and collaborations, turns 34 on October 22.

angles.name: Savage Birthday
angles.copy: Shaayaa Bin Abraham-Joseph, better known as 21 Savage, celebrates his 34th birthday on October 22nd! Drop your favourite 21 Savage track!

angles.name: Rapper's Birthday
angles.copy: It's 21 Savage's 34th birthday this Tuesday! Time to put on some of his biggest hits.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Zac Hanson
moments.blurb: Zac Hanson, the youngest member and drummer of the pop-rock band Hanson, turns 41 on October 22.

angles.name: MMMBop Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 41st Birthday to Zac Hanson! The youngest member of Hanson, responsible for those iconic drums. What's your favourite Hanson tune?

angles.name: Still Mmmbopping
angles.copy: Can you believe Zac Hanson turns 41 on October 22nd? Time flies when you're making great music! Celebrate with a Hanson classic.

moments.title: GlasGLOW Kicks Off
moments.blurb: GlasGLOW, Glasgow's popular family-friendly Halloween adventure trail at the Botanic Gardens, begins its run on October 23.

angles.name: Glasgow Gets Spooky
angles.copy: GlasGLOW returns to Glasgow Botanic Gardens this Friday, October 23rd! Get ready for a spectacular Halloween adventure trail. Will you be going?

angles.name: Halloween Fun in Scotland
angles.copy: North of the border, GlasGLOW brings a spooky, illuminated trail to Glasgow's Botanic Gardens from Friday! Perfect for some family frights.

moments.title: Halloween in the City Manchester
moments.blurb: Manchester's Halloween in the City, a week-long celebration of spooky installations and events across the city centre, begins on October 24.

angles.name: Manchester Gets Spooky
angles.copy: Get ready, Manchester! Halloween in the City kicks off this Saturday with spooky installations and events taking over the city centre. What are you looking forward to?

angles.name: City Centre Haunts
angles.copy: From Saturday, Manchester's city centre transforms for Halloween in the City! Perfect for some pre-Halloween frights and fun.

moments.title: Premier League Next Weekend
moments.blurb: Next weekend's Premier League action includes big clashes like Aston Villa vs Manchester City and Chelsea vs Tottenham Hotspur.

angles.name: Next Week's PL Buzz
angles.copy: Looking ahead to next weekend's Premier League! Saturday sees Aston Villa host Man City, Arsenal take on Everton, and Chelsea clash with Spurs. Huge games coming up!

angles.name: Sunday PL Action
angles.copy: Next Sunday in the Premier League: Crystal Palace v Newcastle, Liverpool v Brighton, and Man Utd v Bournemouth. Who's picking up crucial points?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Keith Urban
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning country superstar Keith Urban, known for hits like 'Somebody Like You' and 'Blue Ain't Your Color', turns 59 on October 26.

angles.name: Country Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the incredible Keith Urban on October 26th! What's your favourite Keith Urban power ballad or upbeat track?

angles.name: Urban's Big Day
angles.copy: Celebrate Keith Urban's 59th birthday next Monday! The country music icon is still touring and making hits.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Bootsy Collins
moments.blurb: Funk legend Bootsy Collins, influential bassist for James Brown and Parliament-Funkadelic, known for his flamboyant style, turns 75 on October 26.

angles.name: Funkadelic Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the iconic Bootsy Collins on October 26th! Get down with some serious funk to celebrate the legendary bassist.

angles.name: Legendary Bassist
angles.copy: Give it up for Bootsy Collins, turning 75 this Monday! The man who helped define funk music. What's your favourite Bootsy track or P-Funk jam?

moments.title: Derry Halloween 40th Anniversary
moments.blurb: Europe's largest Halloween festival, Derry Halloween, celebrates its 40th anniversary from October 28-31 with four days and nights of spectacular events.

angles.name: Derry's Big Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Derry Halloween celebrates its 40th anniversary from October 28th! Get ready for four days of folklore, fire, and frights in Europe's largest Halloween festival.

angles.name: Northern Ireland Haunts
angles.copy: Planning a trip to Derry for Halloween? Their 40th anniversary festival promises to be bigger and spookier than ever, starting October 28th!
